Markets.title: Demat 2.0 will bring instant bond settlement closer, trading after regulation and market readiness: NSDL MD
Markets.summary: NSDL Managing Director Vijay Chandok stated that Demat 2.0 could enable instant bond settlements using central bank digital currency. However, wider implementation depends on market readiness and regulatory approval.

Markets.title: BlackRock private credit fund sees redemption pressure ease in third quarter
Markets.summary: Redemption requests for BlackRock's flagship private credit fund decreased in the third quarter. This drop, along with declining withdrawal requests at other BlackRock funds, suggests easing pressure within the private credit sector.

Markets.title: Granules India promoter sells 1.72 crore shares worth Rs 1,500 crore; Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas among investors
Markets.summary: Granules India promoter Krishna Prasad Chigurupati sold 1.72 crore shares for approximately Rs 1,500 crore to institutional investors like Goldman Sachs and BNP Paribas. The share sale reduced the promoter's stake to 31.08% to fund the second tranche of a preferential issue.

Markets.title: Fed rate-hike bets rise to 85% after hot August inflation data
Markets.summary: Hot August inflation data and rising oil prices have caused traders to estimate an 85% chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike. Core consumer prices exceeded economists' forecasts, indicating an upward trajectory for inflation.

Markets.title: Gold climbs on dip buying, Fed hike bets rise after US inflation data
Markets.summary: Gold prices rose over one percent on Friday due to dip buying and found a short-term floor. Strong U.S. inflation data increased expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next week.

Markets.title: NSEL settlement scheme: Sebi settles proceedings against 91 commodity brokers
Markets.summary: Sebi settled proceedings with 91 commodity brokers linked to the NSEL issue under a new settlement scheme. The brokers agreed to settlement fees and temporary restrictions on proprietary trading and onboarding new clients.

Geo-Political.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
Geo-Political.summary: The Iran-backed Houthis claimed a major military advance in Yemen, including the seizure of the strategic island of Perim. This action tightens the group's grip on the critical Red Sea shipping lane.

Geo-Political.title: Norway's Princess Astrid dies two days after attending brother King Harald's funeral
Geo-Political.summary: Norway's Princess Astrid has died just two days after attending the funeral of her brother, King Harald. The new king, Haakon VIII, paid tribute to his aunt, praising the warm and dutiful manner in which she represented the Royal House.

Geo-Political.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
Geo-Political.summary: Israel destroyed a major underground Hezbollah base in a massive blast. The explosion generated seismic activity equivalent to a 4.1 magnitude earthquake, as recorded by the US Geological Survey.

Geo-Political.title: Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' goes up for auction
Geo-Political.summary: Princess Diana's famous "revenge dress" is scheduled for auction by Sotheby's on December 9. The auction house expects the garment to sell for up to $300,000 (£220,000).

Geo-Political.title: Buddhist monk arrested in suspected $3m embezzlement scandal
Geo-Political.summary: Thai police arrested a Buddhist monk and a female accomplice in connection with a suspected three million dollar embezzlement scheme. The monk, who had taken a vow of celibacy, was also filmed having sex with the accomplice.

Geo-Political.title: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
Geo-Political.summary: AI company Anthropic recently blocked an apparent attempt to use its artificial intelligence models to help create biological weapons. This discovery follows recent warnings from a former top Anthropic researcher regarding the severe risks advanced AI poses to humanity.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when querying ChatGPT. This happened without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide outlines ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These applications help digital creators streamline their workflows and maintain a competitive edge in an evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced AI tools designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and boost productivity across various industries. These market-leading applications leverage technologies like natural language processing to drive efficiency and innovation.

AI & Tech.summary: Artificial intelligence content generators help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material for their audiences. Because numerous AI writing tools are available in 2022, choosing the right one can be challenging.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate explains how the network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi urges BRICS to turn its growing economic weight into stronger trade, investment and business partnerships
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged BRICS nations to reduce trade barriers and strengthen business and investment partnerships. He also promoted India's infrastructure, startups, and digital public infrastructure as drivers of global growth.

Data & Insights.title: Modi meets Pezeshkian amid US-Iran War: Seafarers’ safety in West Asia, BRICS cooperation discussed
Data & Insights.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met on the sidelines of the BRICS Summit to discuss strengthening bilateral ties. Their discussions focused on seafarers' safety in West Asia and enhanced cooperation in multilateral forums.

Data & Insights.title: India’s 7.8% Q1 GDP growth ‘above our expectations’, says IMF amid energy price shock
Data & Insights.summary: The IMF reported that India's economy grew by a better-than-expected 7.8% in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. This strong performance, supported by improved data transparency, highlights India's resilience as a global growth engine despite energy price shocks.

Data & Insights.title: In New Delhi, Putin pitches BRICS investment platform, says bloc’s growth outpaces G7 - ‘World is always changing’
Data & Insights.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin proposed a BRICS digital investment platform via the New Development Bank to mobilize private funding and enhance economic competitiveness. He also stated during a summit in New Delhi that the bloc's economic growth is outpacing the G7.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: From trade to defence, energy and space - What transpired during Modi-Putin meeting
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin met during the BRICS Summit to review bilateral cooperation. According to the Ministry of External Affairs, they discussed progress in political, economic, defence, energy, space, skills mobility, and people-to-people domains.

Data & Insights.title: Modi-Putin meet: $100 billion trade target by 2030, nuclear energy, critical minerals likely focus areas, says report
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Prime Minister Modi and Russian President Putin are expected to set an ambitious bilateral trade target of $100 billion by 2030. According to reports, their upcoming meeting will also focus on expanding cooperation in nuclear energy and critical minerals.

India.title: BRICS Summit 2026 LIVE Updates: Putin, Pezeshkian Highlight Issue Of Sanctions At BRICS Business Forum
India.summary: As the BRICS Chair for 2026, India will host the BRICS Summit in New Delhi on September 12 and 13. During the BRICS Business Forum, leaders including Vladimir Putin and Masoud Pezeshkian highlighted the issue of sanctions.

India.title: Putin Takes "40%" Dig At G7, Compares It With BRICS' Contribution To World GDP
India.summary: At the BRICS Business Forum, Russian President Vladimir Putin noted that BRICS now contributes 40 percent to the world's GDP. He compared this figure to the declining global economic share of the G7 nations.

India.title: Delhi Lt Governor Proposes Mandatory Tuberculosis Test For All Hospital Patients
India.summary: Delhi's Lieutenant Governor has proposed making tuberculosis tests mandatory for all hospital patients. The proposal aims to help the city meet key targets under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan before the September 30 deadline.

India.title: US Envoy Sergio Gor Visits Manipur, Meets Governor, Chief Minister
India.summary: US Envoy Sergio Gor visited the Indian state of Manipur to meet with the Governor and Chief Minister. During his visit, he toured the historic Kangla Fort, the ancient center of the erstwhile Manipur kingdom.

India.title: After Congress Comments On Punjab's Schools, AAP's Himachal Counter
India.summary: Congress leader Sachin Pilot questioned a school audit in Punjab, sparking a verbal exchange with the Aam Aadmi Party. In response, AAP issued a counter-statement regarding Himachal Pradesh.

India.title: Carplomacy 4.0: PM Modi, Putin Share A Ride Again After Bilateral Talks
India.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin shared a car ride following their bilateral talks on Friday. This marks the fourth time the two leaders have traveled together in a car, following previous joint rides in China and on two other occasions.

General.title: An extraordinary result - why did MPs reject assisted dying bill this time?
General.summary: MPs rejected the assisted dying bill, causing the campaign to lose its current momentum. Supporters have stated that they will attempt to introduce the legislation again in the future.

General.title: 'Never, ever forget' - America marks 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
General.summary: America is marking the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks with solemn ceremonies. These memorial events are taking place in New York, the Pentagon, and Pennsylvania.

General.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
General.summary: The Iran-backed Houthis claimed a major advance in Yemen. They also reportedly seized Perim, a strategic island along a major Red Sea shipping route.

General.title: How global trade and oil prices could be hit by Houthi advance
General.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels have captured territory near the Bab al-Mandab Strait. This strategic chokepoint is essential for international shipping and global oil trade.

General.title: UK government rejects 'kill switch' idea for dangerous AI
General.summary: The UK government has rejected the idea of implementing a "kill switch" to shut down dangerous artificial intelligence. The Cabinet Office stated that the country cannot simply turn off AI systems.
